articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a 2 million token context window and significantly improved extended reasoning capabilities. The model reportedly outperforms competitors on complex multi-step coding and scientific analysis benchmarks. Anthropic claims Claude 4 sets a new standard for safety alignment alongside raw performance.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Human-Level Performance on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 has surpassed human-level performance across all major medical licensing examinations, including the USMLE and UK PLAB tests. The multimodal model can interpret medical imaging alongside patient notes to generate diagnostic recommendations. The announcement has reignited debate around AI deployment in clinical settings.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Agent Platform for Enterprise Autonomous Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has unveiled a new enterprise-focused agentic platform built on GPT-5, allowing businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents capable of managing multi-step workflows across internal tools and databases. The platform includes built-in audit trails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints designed to satisfy corporate compliance requirements. Early adopters including Salesforce and SAP have already integrated the system into production environments.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over Llama Model Transparency
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office levied a €350 million fine against Meta for failing to disclose adequate training data documentation for its Llama model series, marking the first major enforcement action under the EU AI Act. Regulators cited insufficient transparency around data provenance and potential copyright violations. Meta has announced it will appeal the decision while updating its model cards to meet compliance standards.

articles.title: Microsoft Introduces RAG-Optimized Azure AI Search with Real-Time Knowledge Grounding
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to Azure AI Search, introducing native retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with real-time knowledge grounding for enterprise document repositories. The new architecture reduces hallucination rates by an estimated 40% in internal benchmarks by tightly coupling vector search with live data connectors. The update is generally available across all Azure regions starting this week.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Releases Comprehensive 2026 AI Index Report Highlighting Compute Cost Collapse
articles.summary: Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute published its annual AI Index, finding that the cost of training frontier models has dropped by 68% year-over-year due to hardware efficiency gains and improved training techniques. The report also notes a record 1,400 open-source AI model releases in Q1 2026, surpassing all of 2024 combined. Researchers warn that democratized access is accelerating dual-use risks alongside beneficial applications.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Edge 3B, a Compact Model Designed for On-Device Inference
articles.summary: French AI startup Mistral AI has released Mistral Edge 3B, a highly quantized 3-billion parameter model optimized to run entirely on consumer smartphones and laptops without cloud connectivity. The model achieves performance comparable to GPT-3.5 on common reasoning tasks while consuming under 2GB of memory. Mistral is positioning the release as a privacy-first alternative for sensitive enterprise and personal use cases.

articles.title: Runway and Adobe Announce Joint Video Generation Integration Embedded in Premiere Pro
articles.summary: Runway and Adobe have formalized a deep integration partnership, embedding Runway's Gen-4 Turbo video generation model directly into Adobe Premiere Pro's timeline editor. Users can now generate, extend, and restyle video clips using natural language prompts without leaving the editing environment. The collaboration signals a broader shift toward AI-native creative tooling in professional media production.
